experienceDescriptions.1: Coordinate requirements and integration work with AI, IoT, infrastructure, security, and UI/UX engineers. Resolve production issues together and adapt priorities while moving software from development through release.
experienceDescriptions.2: Completed the Machine Learning track through a team capstone, GiziLens. Coordinated web app work with the food-recognition team, clarifying API needs and aligning integration across disciplines while contributing the app's accounts, sessions, and user APIs.
experienceDescriptions.3: Learned Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Vue through guided exercises, connecting each interface to its API.
experienceDescriptions.4: Completed a full-time backend engineering program (MSIB Batch 6) with a project that adapted AskIn, an open-source AI chat app. Built authenticated APIs, model routing, and deployment.
experienceDescriptions.5: Completed a three-month SEO traineeship at the Jakarta office. Researched search queries, reviewed technical SEO issues, and used analytics to decide which pages and topics needed attention.
experienceDescriptions.6: Completed the Cloud Computing path of Bangkit 2023 Batch 2 through a three-track capstone, Parentify. Built the cloud side with mobile and machine-learning teammates, agreeing on API contracts and documenting the decisions.
